responsibility: Supplies the Darwin 8.0+ rs6000 compatibility override for system library selection at link time. Rather than redefining the full Darwin target, this header narrowly replaces LIB_SPEC so PowerPC Darwin links against libSystemStubs for newer Mac OS X toolchains, conditionally inserts the old libmx compatibility library for non-64-bit builds targeting the 10.3/10.4 transition, and then links libSystem, capturing the version-specific runtime-library ordering required by Darwin 8 and later.
